narrative: Qualcomm's June 24 Dragonfly roadmap surfaces the hardware half of the same anti-Nvidia inference push -- a full CPU-plus-accelerator stack with Meta as named customer -- demonstrably executing the silicon-agnostic attack rivals must answer. That escalation raises the competitive pressure on AMD, Intel, or a hyperscaler silicon arm to secure comparable cross-vendor runtime independence.
remaining_gap: No rival has acquired a CUDA-agnostic inference compiler; today reinforces the catalyzing Qualcomm push but documents no counter-acquisition.
